_about: Check of the backgrounds Jemma has against Dittobase’s per-background pages (fetched 10 Nov 2026; their page data includes caught and “evolved” ones). our_id is the dex.json entry id or costumes.json costume id that would show it. how: caught = obtainable with the background; evolved = by evolving, changing form or fusing. Shadow, Dynamax and Gigantamax are boxes on an entry, not separate ids. Nothing here has been applied to data/.

Team-based rewards follow her team (Instinct), so the Ultra Unlock items are listed for completeness only, not suggested.
